limits: The public tree was changing as reporting and registration artifacts were added; rescan the final release copy after main/replay/results are complete.
Identifier searches cover known supplied account/record/thread metadata only.

The phrase check covers exact twenty-word alphabetic sequences in the new candidate pool; it does not rule out shorter excerpts, paraphrases or historical/private-export prose. Historical and reserve writing were intentionally not inspected.
Absence of pattern matches is not a proof that arbitrary secrets or personal data cannot occur.
material_reporting_note: Protocol already covers substantive study limitations. Final release should additionally distinguish reproducible analysis of public sanitized cases from source-level reproduction that requires authorized access to private cohort/exclusion/source records.
registration_relationship: Reporting/privacy review only; created after scoring registration, not a preregistered analytical check. Existing frozen artifacts were not changed.

release_path_redaction.recommended_action: Preserve immutable operational originals. Produce a separate release copy with declared logical-root placeholders and an original/released SHA256 redaction manifest. Do not call redacted command paths exact original argv.

scope.private_inputs: Identifier metadata plus automated phrase comparison of new candidate writing only. No historical or reserve writing or feature vectors were read.
